label: Mercy for the Fallen
desc: Lay to rest the zombie soldiers wandering the Verdant Vale.

label: The Lost Locket
desc: Retrieve a family heirloom from the eastern ruins. Look for it among the fallen soldiers.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Lira
acceptDialogue.text: Oh — you're actually stopping. Most people just walk past.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Lira
acceptDialogue.text: I lost my locket out in the eastern ruins. Silver, with a little blue gem. My grandmother gave it to me before everything fell apart.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Lira
acceptDialogue.text: I know it's dangerous out there. But if you happen to pass through... would you keep an eye out for it?

activeDialogue.speaker: Lira
activeDialogue.text: The locket... it's silver, blue gem. Somewhere in the eastern ruins, I think. You'll know it when you see it.

submitDialogue.speaker: Lira
submitDialogue.text: You found it. You actually found it.

submitDialogue.speaker: Lira
submitDialogue.text: I didn't dare hope. After everything that's happened, hoping feels dangerous.

submitDialogue.speaker: Lira
submitDialogue.text: Take these — I had them set aside for a reason. I just didn't know who the reason was yet.

label: Void Sentinel
desc: A Mutant has been sighted near the Vale. Defeat it to study the infection.

label: Goblin Menace
desc: Elder Maren asks you to drive back the goblin raiders preying on the refugee camp.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Elder Maren
acceptDialogue.text: You are strong enough. I can see it. The camp has been hit three nights running — goblins, a small warband from the eastern ridgeline.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Elder Maren
acceptDialogue.text: I cannot ask the refugees to fight. Half of them are children. But if you could drive the raiders back — four, maybe five of them — we could breathe again. Will you help us?

activeDialogue.speaker: Elder Maren
activeDialogue.text: The goblins are still out there. I can hear them at the treeline after dark. Please — we cannot take another night of this.

submitDialogue.speaker: Elder Maren
submitDialogue.text: You... you really did it.

submitDialogue.speaker: Elder Maren
submitDialogue.text: I stood at the gate last night and listened. Nothing. Not one sound from the ridge. The children slept through till morning for the first time in weeks.

submitDialogue.speaker: Elder Maren
submitDialogue.text: This is everything I have left to give. It is not much, but it is given freely.

label: Bones of the Fallen
desc: The Archivist needs bone shards to document the soldiers who died in the Crystal Cavern.

acceptDialogue.speaker: The Archivist
acceptDialogue.text: There are soldiers down here who have no record. No name, no unit, no date. They died in the dark and nobody wrote it down.

acceptDialogue.speaker: The Archivist
acceptDialogue.text: Bone shards carry resonance. Three fragments — enough to reconstruct the elemental signature of the conflict. I can at least record that something happened here, and approximately when.

acceptDialogue.speaker: The Archivist
acceptDialogue.text: History does not need to be perfect. It only needs to exist. Will you help me make sure this one does?

activeDialogue.speaker: The Archivist
activeDialogue.text: Still cataloguing. The resonance patterns here are... layered. Come back when you have the fragments.

submitDialogue.speaker: The Archivist
submitDialogue.text: Three. Yes. This is sufficient.

submitDialogue.speaker: The Archivist
submitDialogue.text: I will be able to date the engagement within a season. Name the elements involved. Confirm it was soldiers and not something else entirely.

submitDialogue.speaker: The Archivist
submitDialogue.text: You understand what you have done? Somewhere, eventually, someone will read an archive and know that people fought here and that it mattered. That is not nothing. Take this.

label: Drive Back the Naga
desc: The Isle Elder needs the naga raiding the survivor settlement pushed back into the sea.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Elder
acceptDialogue.text: The naga come at low tide. Always low tide — they know when the shallows open up. Four of them, sometimes five, and they take whatever they can carry.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Elder
acceptDialogue.text: We have been patient. Aethon patience — the kind you develop when the sea takes something from you every year and you stay anyway. But there are limits.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Elder
acceptDialogue.text: Drive them back. Not destroy — we do not ask for that. Just make it cost enough that they look elsewhere. Can you do that?

activeDialogue.speaker: Elder
activeDialogue.text: The naga are still circling at low tide. The settlement cannot rest. Please, when you can.

submitDialogue.speaker: Elder
submitDialogue.text: We watched from the ridge. You moved like the current — no wasted motion.

submitDialogue.speaker: Elder
submitDialogue.text: They will not come back soon. They are cautious creatures, despite everything. They learn.

submitDialogue.speaker: Elder
submitDialogue.text: The settlement breathes easier today. Here — we set this aside for whoever helped us. We just did not know who that would be yet.

label: Forge Relics
desc: Collect 4 Forge Cores from the corrupted machines to help Kaelen repair his crawler.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Kaelen
acceptDialogue.text: You look sturdy. I got pinned here by the Sentinels.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Kaelen
acceptDialogue.text: If you can rip 4 cores out of those walking furnaces, I can fix my rig and get out of this ash-pit.

activeDialogue.speaker: Kaelen
activeDialogue.text: Don't touch the perimeter... they're still active...

submitDialogue.speaker: Kaelen
submitDialogue.text: You actually got them. These cores are still burning hot... incredible.

submitDialogue.speaker: Kaelen
submitDialogue.text: Here, take this. I won't need it if my rig runs.

label: Resonance Cull
desc: Clear out the resonant shards disrupting the scholar's instruments.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Scholar Vane
acceptDialogue.text: The frequency in this cavern is extraordinary, but those jagged shards are throwing off my readings!

acceptDialogue.speaker: Scholar Vane
acceptDialogue.text: Clear them out so I can calibrate the dial.

activeDialogue.speaker: Scholar Vane
activeDialogue.text: I can't hear the baseline over that awful ringing...

submitDialogue.speaker: Scholar Vane
submitDialogue.text: Perfect! The baseline is stabilizing.

submitDialogue.speaker: Scholar Vane
submitDialogue.text: The resonance... it's singing now. Take this for your trouble.

label: Tide Clearance
desc: Defeat 3 Naga blocking the trade routes on the Southern Isles.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Isle Merchant
acceptDialogue.text: The trade routes are blocked. These Naga are tearing apart any ship that gets close.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Isle Merchant
acceptDialogue.text: If you can clear out a few of them, I can finally move these goods.

activeDialogue.speaker: Isle Merchant
activeDialogue.text: The tides are dangerous... be careful out there.

submitDialogue.speaker: Isle Merchant
submitDialogue.text: Trade is finally flowing again. The tides are kind.

submitDialogue.speaker: Isle Merchant
submitDialogue.text: Here is your cut. You earned it.

label: A Second Chance
desc: Deliver your grandmother's locket to the Sacred Ruins where the Void Knight fell. Give Arren the peace he earned.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Lira
acceptDialogue.text: Arren... his name was Arren.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Lira
acceptDialogue.text: The Commander told me. He was the one who held the road until the end. He wasn't a monster. He was a hero who got lost in the dark.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Lira
acceptDialogue.text: I want to give him something back. My locket... the one you found. It was meant for a protector. I want you to take it to the ruins. Place it where he fell.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Lira
acceptDialogue.text: Tell him... tell him the road is safe now. He can stop watching.

activeDialogue.speaker: Lira
activeDialogue.text: The locket. Take it to the Sacred Ruins, to the center of the bridge where the shadow finally lifted.

submitDialogue.speaker: Lira
submitDialogue.text: You're back. Did you... did you tell him?

submitDialogue.speaker: Aya
submitDialogue.text: The ruins are quiet now, Lira. The weight is gone.

submitDialogue.speaker: Lira
submitDialogue.text: Thank you. I think... I think I can finally start looking forward now, instead of just looking back.

submitDialogue.speaker: Lira
submitDialogue.text: I'm going to help the Azure Commanders rebuild. It's what he would have wanted.

label: The Hollow Guard
desc: Recover scattered squad insignias near the eastern woods to spare fallen Vale soldiers from King Galdor's golden treasury.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Fallen Guard
acceptDialogue.text: Cough... you carry no rot. Listen to me... the vanguard...

acceptDialogue.speaker: Fallen Guard
acceptDialogue.text: My squad... their insignias lie scattered near the eastern woods. Bury them... break the gold's hold before their souls are pulled into the King's treasury.

activeDialogue.speaker: Fallen Guard
activeDialogue.text: Find the insignias... do not let the King claim their names...

submitDialogue.speaker: Fallen Guard
submitDialogue.text: The weight... it lifts. I can feel the pure air again.

submitDialogue.speaker: Fallen Guard
submitDialogue.text: They are free. My vanguard walks unchained. Take this... my vigil is done.

label: Price of Neutrality
desc: Recover and cleanse the Void-sealed idol discarded near the western cascades to weaken the River King's mitigation shield.

acceptDialogue.speaker: Guilt-Ridden Merchant
acceptDialogue.text: Please... don't hurt me! I can't go forward or back! The bridges are closed!

acceptDialogue.speaker: Guilt-Ridden Merchant
acceptDialogue.text: To secure lifelong free passage, I surrendered a Void-sealed idol directly into the River King's treasury! It accelerated his corruption!

acceptDialogue.speaker: Guilt-Ridden Merchant
acceptDialogue.text: The cursed idol lies discarded in the weeds near the western cascades... please, recover and purify it! It will break his shield!

activeDialogue.speaker: Guilt-Ridden Merchant
activeDialogue.text: The idol is in the river weeds... cleanse it before facing him!

submitDialogue.speaker: Guilt-Ridden Merchant
submitDialogue.text: You cleansed it! The dark resonance is completely gone!

submitDialogue.speaker: Guilt-Ridden Merchant
submitDialogue.text: His shield is shattered! You've given us all a chance to cross safely. Take this... it's the least I can do.
